enchantments.tooltip: +1 Enhancement Bonus: +1 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Chilling 2: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to become frozen to the touch, dealing 2d6 Ice damage on each hit.
Monstrous Humanoid Bane 2: This weapon is attuned specifically to hunt those who are descended from monsters dealing an additional 2d10 bane damage vs. Monstrous Humanoids.
Weakening 1: This weapon saps the power and might from your enemies, dealing 1 Strength damage on each hit.
Flametouched Iron: Flametouched Iron grants +1 saves versus Evil Outsiders.
